name: llms-ink
description: Read public sites, docs, GitHub repos, PDFs and videos as llms.txt; build cited context packs, read your dependencies' docs, take video notes and fix llms.txt files.

interface.shortDescription: Read any public link as text
interface.longDescription: Turn public websites, docs sections, GitHub repositories, PDFs and videos into llms.txt and llms-full.txt. Skills read a source with citations, build and refresh context packs, collect your dependencies' docs, write timestamped video notes, and check or write a site's llms.txt. Public sources only; anonymous use has shared daily limits, and an optional LLMS_INK_KEY gives you your own quota.
defaultPrompt: Use llms.ink to read this repo and explain how to set it up.
Collect the docs for my project's dependencies into a context pack.
Turn this video into chaptered notes with timestamps.
